_note: K4: buys per player and round (src/coach/derive/economy, docs/coach/utility.md).

buys._window: Purchases count from the round start to the round's buytime_ended (fallback: freeze end + buyTimeSec). item_purchase records after it are not purchases (the test demo has 90 of them mid-round).
buys._class: A player's own buy class uses his own equipment value at freeze end with the team thresholds of data/coach/tuning.json economy (eco below, full from); pistol rounds are pistol.

sync._detector: Rounds where the player's class is a buy (force or full) and at least minTeammates teammates are eco, or the player is eco and at least minTeammates teammates buy. A finding needs minRounds.

kitArmor._detector: CT gun rounds (a primary after the buy) without a kit with at least the kit's price left; a primary rifle or sniper with no armor; a full buy with more than leftoverMin left and at most maxGrenadesLeftover grenades. A finding needs minRounds.

scoring._impact: Fights per round on K5's unified scale (docs/coach/report.md): a buy out of sync with three teammates a quarter of a fight, a missing kit / armor / leftover money a quarter. The prioritizer scales both by the lobby excess.
